modes.name: trunk_shift_forward
modes.plus: trunk moves forward over feet (feet move back relative to base)
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_shift_left
modes.plus: trunk shifts left (feet move right relative to base)
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_right
modes.plus: trunk rolls right: right side lowers, left rises
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_pitch_down
modes.plus: nose pitches down: front legs fold, rear extend
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along pitch

modes.name: fl_tip_up
modes.plus: FL foot lifts up and back
modes.minus: FL foot reaches forward and up

modes.name: fl_tip_left
modes.plus: FL foot moves out left and up

modes.name: fr_tip_up
modes.plus: FR foot lifts up and back
modes.minus: FR foot reaches forward and up

modes.name: fr_tip_right
modes.plus: FR foot moves out right and up

modes.name: rl_tip_up
modes.plus: RL foot lifts up and back
modes.minus: RL foot reaches forward and up

modes.name: rl_tip_left
modes.plus: RL foot moves out left and up

modes.name: rr_tip_up
modes.plus: RR foot lifts up and back
modes.minus: RR foot reaches forward and up

modes.name: rr_tip_right
modes.plus: RR foot moves out right and up

modes.name: tail_s_right
modes.plus: tail base swings right, tip back left (S shape)

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: trunk yaws left: front feet go right, rear feet go left relative to base
